newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices extend daytime slide.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices extend daytime slide.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures prices extended daytime losses in overnight Thursday trade, weighted by thin volume and forecasts of above normal temperatures next week in the northeastern U.S., brokers said.
"The heat is so weak with the weather warming," a New York-based trader said.
After falling 0.56 cents a gallon in the day session, March NYMEX heating oil dropped 1.03 cents several hours into ACCESS, amid volume of 70 lots.
April crude fell 13 cents from the settlement to $20.76 a barrel, as 815 lots changed hands in the front-month. Overall activity stood at 975 lots.
March gasoline futures, which expire tomorrow along with heating oil, traded 62.15 cents, down 0.52 cents a gallon as volumes stood at 51 lots.
